name: read_file
description: Reads file content. Reads up to 2000 lines by default. When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part: use `offset` and `limit`.

offset.description: Optional line number to start reading from (1-indexed). Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Optional number of lines to read. Defaults to 2000.

name: read_file_with_line_numbers
description: Reads file content, including line numbers. You MUST use this tool to retrieve line numbers before making an edit with edit_file. Reads up to 2000 lines by default. When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part: use `offset` and `limit`.

offset.description: Optional line number to start reading from (1-indexed). Defaults to 1. Line numbers stay those of the file.

limit.description: Optional number of lines to read. Defaults to 2000.
